decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album "Country Life," and two distinct albums share that title. Document D1S1 explicitly identifies Roxy Music as the artist of the 1974 album *Country Life*. Document D2S1 identifies Show of Hands as the artist of the 2003 album *Country Life*. These are separate referents with valid claims under the same title. Neither document contradicts the other, and both directly address the requested relation (artist of the album). Therefore, both answers are preserved as distinct and valid.
